items.title: File Widerspruch against BAföG Bescheid
items.quote: Wenn Sie diese Entscheidung überprüfen lassen möchten, legen Sie innerhalb eines Monats nach ihrer Bekanntgabe Widerspruch beim Studierendenwerk Mustertor, Mensaweg 2, 35392 Mustertor, ein – schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: Letter dated Mon 5 May 2025 (date of document, actual posting can only be later). As a letter from a public-law authority (Anstalt des öffentlichen Rechts) sent by ordinary post, it counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting (§ 37 Abs. 2 SGB X analogously applied by administrative authorities post-2025 reform): Fri 9 May 2025. Per § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of delivery is not counted; the one-month Widerspruch period (§ 70 VwGO / Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung) runs from Sat 10 May and ends, per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, on the day in the following month bearing the same number as the delivery day: Mon 9 June 2025. That day is Pfingstmontag, a nationwide public holiday, so under § 193 BGB the deadline shifts to the next business day: Tue 10 June 2025.

items.title: Report changes in income, housing or course of study immediately
items.quote: Teilen Sie uns Änderungen bei Ihrem Einkommen, Ihrer Wohnung oder Ihrem Studium bitte sofort mit.
items.computation: This is a standing obligation to notify the Studierendenwerk 'sofort' (immediately) whenever such a change occurs during the Bewilligungszeitraum (04/2025–03/2026); the letter sets no fixed calendar date, so no single due date can be computed — the obligation is triggered anew by each future change.

warnings: The letter states BAföG of €734.00/month is paid at the end of each month for the following month ('Die Zahlung erfolgt jeweils zum Monatsende für den folgenden Monat') for the period 04/2025–03/2026; this is a recurring payment schedule rather than a single deadline, so it is not listed as a dated item.
